title: Update contact email across frontend UI, mailto links, and SEO copy

requirements.summary: Replace the old contact email with shreefireworks@yahoo.com everywhere it appears in frontend UI text, mailto links, and SEO/meta descriptions, ensuring the Contact page still renders and links correctly via siteContent.contact.email.
acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/content/siteContent.ts, siteContent.contact.email is exactly "shreefireworks@yahoo.com" (replacing the current incorrect value).

All mailto links that currently use "shreefirebase@yahoo.com" are updated to "mailto:shreefireworks@yahoo.com" (including frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx and frontend/src/components/CtaBar.tsx).
Any user-visible text that currently shows "shreefirebase@yahoo.com" is updated to "shreefireworks@yahoo.com" (including the footer email label).
In frontend/src/content/seoMeta.ts, the contact page description no longer references "shreefirebase@yahoo.com" and instead references "shreefireworks@yahoo.com".
The Contact page email card continues to render the updated email via siteContent.contact.email and opens the correct email address when clicked.

file_operations.description: Update siteContent.contact.email to exactly "shreefireworks@yahoo.com" so all content sourcing this value reflects the corrected email.
Replace the hardcoded footer email text and the mailto href currently using "shreefirebase@yahoo.com" so they use "shreefireworks@yahoo.com".
Update the Email Us button mailto link to use "mailto:shreefireworks@yahoo.com" instead of the old address.
Update seoMeta.contact.description to reference "shreefireworks@yahoo.com" (and remove any mention of "shreefirebase@yahoo.com").
Verify the Contact page email card continues to render from siteContent.contact.email and that the mailto link composes from that value (no hardcoded old email remains).
